recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內有數個邊界模糊、淡染的結節狀區域，周圍是較深染的淋巴球，中間穿插粉紅色纖維血管帶；結節輪廓不清、缺乏清楚的套膜區，與典型反應性濾泡不同，是 AITL 可見的模糊結節型態。
features: Vaguely nodular, ill-defined pale-staining areas separated by darker lymphocyte-rich zones
Nodules lack sharp borders and well-formed mantle zones
Branching eosinophilic fibrovascular bands traversing the center of the field
A dilated vascular space at left and a vessel at the right edge
Cytologic detail not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power lymph node section shows effacement of the normal architecture by vaguely nodular, ill-defined pale-staining areas alternating with darker lymphocyte-rich zones and traversed by branching eosinophilic fibrovascular bands. Well-formed follicles with distinct mantle zones are not identified. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (PD-1, CXCL13, CD10 and expanded CD21-positive FDC meshworks), findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back, crowded, well-defined neoplastic follicles composed of centrocytes and centroblasts with BCL2-positive germinal centers.
NLPHL shows large expansile nodules containing scattered CD20-positive LP cells rimmed by PD-1-positive T cells, rather than diffuse TFH-derived neoplastic T cells.
Reactive nodes show well-demarcated follicles with polarized germinal centers and intact mantles and lack clonal TFH T cells.
